blocks.text: PANGLAO, BOHOL, PHILIPPINES – October 26, 2026 – BE Grand Resort Bohol has once again solidified its standing among the world’s most elite hospitality destinations, securing major accolades at the 2026 World Luxury Hotel Awards. This year, the premier luxury resort on Panglao Island achieved top global, continental, and country honors across three competitive categories: An enduring legacy of global Acclaim BE Grand Resort Bohol first captured international spotlight at the World Luxury Hotel Awards in 2018, when it was crowned Southeast Asia’s Luxury Hideaway Resort. Since then, the homegrown luxury destination has maintained a multi-year winning streak, repeatedly earning top […]...
